description: This file declares the interface for the Uplink Shared Channel (UL-SCH) demultiplexer in a 5G NR (New Radio) physical layer implementation. It defines the class 'ulsch_demultiplex' with methods for configuring CSI Part 2 and performing demultiplexing of UL-SCH signals, including associated configuration parameters.

classes.name: ulsch_demultiplex
classes.description: Interface class for UL-SCH demultiplexer handling CSI Part 2 configuration and demultiplexing process.

methods.name: set_csi_part2
methods.description: Configures the CSI Part 2 decoder buffer with specified number of bits and encoded bits.

methods.name: demultiplex
methods.description: Performs the demultiplexing of UL-SCH signals into data, HARQ-ACK, and CSI Part 1 soft bits.
